visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is set in an outdoor urban street near a doorway with a poster. A man wearing a black collared shirt, black tie, and black baseball cap (Yide) is being interviewed by two hosts—one in a white graphic t-shirt and another in a grey shirt with glasses. They are laughing and looking into a black duffle bag. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand wearing a white glove holding a white toy car pulled from the bag. Yide folds his arms and smiles broadly, explaining the item while the camera focuses on his facial expressions and the object. (3) The man holds a small black Marshall speaker. The scene cuts to a different street location where the man is dancing energetically, wearing the same black shirt and camo-patterned pants. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (4) Back to the interview, a yellow tin of 'RESCUE PASTILLES' is held up in a close-up. Yide gestures with his hands toward his chest and neck while speaking. (5) A small purple inspirational card is revealed and held by the host in white gloves. Yide leans back and laughs with his hand over his mouth as the hosts react to the text on the card.
